title: Indonesian wildfires threaten critically-endangered orangutan: IUCN
summary: Fires in Kalimantan and Sumatra have threatened orangutans' habitats, leading to rescues of animals including 53 orangutans by the Indonesian Forestry Ministry.
location: Kalimantan and Sumatra

title: Karhutla Ancam Hutan Khusus Samboja hingga Orangutan Dievakuasi, Upaya Pencegahan Diperkuat
summary: Due to forest fires threatening KHDTK Samboja, 11 rehabilitated orangutans were evacuated from Samboja Lestari by Yayasan Jejak Pulang in collaboration with BKSDA Kalimantan Timur on Tuesday, September 1, 2026.
location: Samboja Barat, Kutai Kartanegara, Kalimantan Timur

title: Drought-stricken orangutan rescued from plantation in East Kalimantan
summary: A male orangutan, approximately 20 years old and severely underweight due to drought conditions, was rescued from a plantation in Menamang Kanan Village, Kutai Kartanegara District, East Kalimantan. The orangutan received emergency medical treatment and is being prepared for rehabilitation.
location: Menamang Kanan Village, Kutai Kartanegara District, East Kalimantan

title: Orangutan Foundation International – 97% of our DNA...100% of Our Commitment! Supporting Conservation and Understanding of Orangutans.Orangutan Foundation International
summary: Orangutan Foundation International and BKSDA rescued a 20-year-old female orangutan named Sari and her one-month-old infant Sara from a wildfire in West Kotawaringin Regency, Central Kalimantan. The mother suffered burn injuries while protecting her infant during the fire.
location: West Kotawaringin Regency, Central Kalimantan, Borneo

title: Ministry probes alleged wildlife violation in burned oil palm concession
summary: A skull of a Bornean orangutan was recovered within an oil palm concession controlled by PT Kayung Agro Lestari, a subsidiary of Singaporean agricultural giant First Resources Ltd., in Ketapang regency, West Kalimantan after wildfire broke out in the firm’s plantation.
location: Ketapang regency, West Kalimantan

title: Female orangutan rescued from wildfire-hit area in Kalimantan
summary: A roughly 20-year-old female orangutan was rescued from a wildfire-scarred area in East Kotawaringin District, Central Kalimantan Province, with the help of BKSDA, Orangutan Foundation International, and Animal Rescue Sampit.
location: East Kotawaringin District, Central Kalimantan Province

title: Forestry Ministry handled 290 wild animals hit by forest fires
summary: The Indonesian Forestry Ministry handled 290 wild animals affected by forest fires, including 96 Bornean orangutans, with rescue efforts involving evacuation to safer habitats, translocation, and care.
location: Kalimantan (specific areas mentioned: Pelang Village, Matan Hilir Selatan Sub-district, Ketapang District, West Kalimantan)

title: Kebakaran Hutan Makin Gerus Habitat Orangutan
summary: The article discusses the impact of forest fires on orangutan habitats in Kalimantan Barat, particularly focusing on efforts to rescue orangutans affected by the fires, such as Orangutan Sampurna in Desa Sungai Awan Kiri.
date: Not explicitly stated; mentions periods from June to September 2026
location: Kabupaten Ketapang, Kalimantan Barat (Kalbar)

title: Orangutan Stories: 2 stranded orangutans given second chances
summary: Two orangutans were rescued from community lands and returned to the Lamandau Wildlife Reserve in Indonesia. The first was a 5-year-old female stranded in a coconut tree, while the second was a previously reintroduced male named Sanubari who had wandered back into a rubber plantation.
location: Lamandau Wildlife Reserve, Indonesia

title: REKAM JEJAK COP SELAMATKAN SATWA PASCA BANJIR TAPANULI SELATAN
summary: COP Centre for Orangutan Protection rescued and provided care to animals affected by a major flood in Tapanuli Selatan, Sumatra.
location: Tapanuli Selatan, Sumatra

title: Dalam Sepekan, Masyarakat Serahkan 2 Bayi Orangutan ke Balai KSDA Kalimantan Tengah
summary: Two baby orangutans were handed over to BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah by local residents in June 2019; one was found being chased by dogs and the other discovered near a village, both were then taken to Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Reintroduction Centre.
location: Kapuas and Katingan Tengah, Kalimantan Tengah, Indonesia

title: Kabar Baik, Begini Kondisi Terkini “Rapala” Orangutan Sumatera
summary: An orphaned Sumatran Orangutan, Rapala, was rescued from a plantation by officials on June 10, 2022, in poor health and separated from its mother. It has since been receiving medical care and rehabilitation at the Batu Mbelin Orangutan Rehabilitation Center.
location: Desa Bukit Selamat, Kecamatan Besitang, Kabupaten Langkat, Sumatera Utara

title: Pelepasliaran Empat Individu Orangutan Hasil Rehabilitasi Di Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya
summary: Four rehabilitated orangutans were released into Bukit Baka Bukit Raya National Park as part of a collaborative effort between Balai Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya, International Animal Rescue (IAR) Indonesia, and Balai Konservasi Sumber Daya Alam Kalimantan Barat. The orangutans had been rescued from various locations across Kalimantan and underwent rehabilitation before being released.
location: Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya, Kalimantan Barat, Indonesia

title: Indonesia's BKSDA steps up Orangutan protection on East Kutai road
summary: A protected orangutan appeared on a company road in East Kutai, Indonesia, and efforts were made by BKSDA, COP, and the company to locate and handle it.
location: PT SHJ's production road in Muara Bengkal, East Kutai, Indonesia

title: DUA PEKAN MENGIKUTI JEJAK EBONI, BAGUS, DAN RUBY
summary: Bagus, Ruby, and Eboni were released into the Busang forest following a long journey from Berau, and their activities were monitored by a Post Release Monitoring (PRM) team for two weeks.
location: Busang forest, near Berau, Kalimantan

title: Kemarau Panjang Picu Orang Utan Keluar dari Habitatnya, 13 Individu Diselamatkan di Kaltim
summary: Sejak Juli 2026, minimal 13 orangutans telah diselamatkan dari kemarau di Kalimantan Timur oleh tim BKSDA Kaltim dan CAN. Salah satu orangutan tersebut berhasil ditranslokasi dan dilepas ke Hutan Kehje Sewen.
location: Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia

title: BKSDA Kalteng Memulai Tahun 2020 dengan Penyelamatan 2 Orangutan Jantan di Pangkalan Bun
summary: Two male orangutans were rescued from Kotawaringin Barat, Kalimantan Tengah, by BKSDA Kalteng and OFI on January 3 and 4, 2020. One was released in Anak Sungai Muara Ali, while the other is undergoing further health checks.
location: Kotawaringin Barat, Kalimantan Tengah

title: Mengenal Konservasi Orangutan Tapanuli di Tapanuli Utara
summary: A Tapanuli Orangutan was rescued twice from human settlements after entering a village and then being found on a road; it was returned to its habitat both times.
location: Adiankoting, Tapanuli Utara, Sumatera Utara

title: PELEPASLIARAN ORANGUTAN DI TAMAN NASIONAL BUKIT BAKA BUKIT RAYA
summary: BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah and BOSF Nyaru Menteng released 12 rehabilitated orangutans, including one repatriated from Thailand, into Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya in February 2017.
location: Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya

title: BKSDA Kalteng Bersama Mitra Akan Lepasliarkan 7 Individu Orangutan
summary: On February 11, 2021, BKSDA Kalteng in collaboration with BOS will release 7 rehabilitated orangutans from the Nyaru Menteng rehabilitation center to Bukit Batikap forest in Murung Raya, Central Kalimantan.
location: Nyaru Menteng (rehabilitation center), Bukit Batikap forest, Murung Raya, Central Kalimantan

title: 51 orang utan diselamatkan dari karhutla di Kalbar
summary: 51 orangutans were rescued from areas affected by forest fires in Ketapang and Kayong Utara, West Kalimantan, between August 6 and October 10, 2026. The rescue included four specific individuals named Lusi, Riri, Mama Rian, and Rian, who were found in poor health due to the impact of the fires.
location: Ketapang and Kayong Utara, West Kalimantan

title: Rescuers scramble to save orangutans as El Niño-boosted fires spread across Borneo
summary: Rescuers from YIARI and BKSDA rescued several orangutans from burning landscapes due to El Niño-boosted fires in Borneo. One mother and infant orangutan (Mama Yayuk and Yayuk) were released into Gunung Palung National Park, while others required medical treatment or evacuation.
location: Borneo, Indonesia (specific areas mentioned: Laman Satong village, Mayak village, Tanjungpura village, Ketapang district, West Kalimantan province)

title: Akibat Karhutla, 7 Orangutan Kalimantan Diselamatkan di Ketapang
summary: Seven orangutans were rescued from their habitats in Ketapang, West Kalimantan, due to forest fires (karhutla) that displaced them into oil palm plantations and residential areas. The rescued individuals included Sampurna, Mama Yayuk with her offspring, Wak, and three others named Mama Yuni, Pura, and Yuni.
location: Ketapang, West Kalimantan

title: Penanganan Karhutla, Prabowo Instruksikan Lindungi Warga dan Selamatkan Satwa
summary: During a wildfire incident, authorities prioritized evacuating wild animals including orangutans to safe habitats. An orangutan named Orangutan Sampurna died after being exposed to excessive smoke in Ketapang.
location: Kalimantan Barat, Indonesia (specifically Ketapang and Kuala Satong)
species_mentioned: Not explicitly mentioned, but assumed to be Bornean orangutan given the location

title: Habitat Terdampak Karhutla, 2 Orangutan Dilaporkan Muncul di Jalan Kota Besi Kalteng
summary: Two orangutans were reported to have appeared near Kota Besi Hulu, Kotawaringin Timur, Kalimantan Tengah, during karhutla (forest fire) damage to their habitat. BKSDA is monitoring the situation and has urged the public not to approach or disturb them.
location: Kota Besi Hulu, Kotawaringin Timur, Kalimantan Tengah

title: Ditemukan Tanpa Induk, Bayi Orangutan Kembali Diselamatkan
summary: A baby female orangutan was rescued by Wild Rescue Unit from masyarakat Dusun Kuala Belian, Desa Pal, Kecamatan Nanga Pinoh, Kabupaten Melawi after it was found abandoned in a forest without its mother.
location: Desa Pal, Kecamatan Nanga Pinoh, Kabupaten Melawi, Kalimantan Barat, Indonesia

title: BKSDA Kalbar Rescue Orangutan Peliharaan Warga
summary: A team from BKSDA Kalbar, along with IAR Indonesia Foundation and Titian Foundation, rescued a 1-year-old Orangutan (pongo pygmaeus) being kept as a pet by a villager in Dusun Teridak, Muara Baru District, Sungai Raya Subdistrict, Kubu Raya Regency. The orangutan was transported to IAR Ketapang for rehabilitation.
location: Dusun Teridak, Muara Baru District, Sungai Raya Subdistrict, Kubu Raya Regency

title: Tim Gabungan Berhasil Mengevakuasi Orangutan Sumatera di Desa Ujung Padang Bakongan
summary: A team including Hocru OIC, BKSDA Aceh, TNGL, and local community members successfully evacuated a Sumatran Orangutan (Pongo abelii) mother and her male infant from an isolated small forest near Gampoeng Padang village in Bakongan, South Aceh. The orangutans were then released back into the Rantau Sialang block of rawa gambut forest.
location: Desa Ujung Padang Bakongan, Kecamatan Bakongan, Kabupaten Aceh Selatan

title: Ketiga Kalinya BBKSDA Sumut Rescue dan Translokasi Orangutan
summary: Balai Besar KSDA Sumatera Utara conducted a rescue and translocation of an individual male Sumatran orangutan (Pongo abelii) from an isolated area in PT PISS plantation to Hutan Restorasi Cinta Raja TNGL, Taman Nasional Gunung Leuser.
location: Areal perkebunan PT. PISS, Desa Makmur, Kecamatan Sei Lepan, Kabupaten Langkat, Sumatera Utara; Hutan Restorasi Cinta Raja Taman Nasional Gunung Leuser

title: BKSDA Kalteng Rescue Orangutan Yang Masuk Kebun Sawit Di Seruyan
summary: A male orangutan weighing 72 kg was rescued by a Wildlife Rescue Unit team from a palm oil plantation in Seruyan, Central Kalimantan, and transported to an Orangutan Care Centre for further examination.
location: Perkebunan sawit PT. Wana Sawit 2, Desa Bahaur, Kabupaten Seruyan, Central Kalimantan

title: Penyerahan Orangutan Sumatera di Sawang Aceh Selatan
summary: An orangutan was voluntarily surrendered by a member of the public to personnel from BKSDA Aceh Subulussalam Resor 15 Tapaktuan. The orangutan will undergo rehabilitation at Pusat Karantina-Rehabilitasi Orangutan Sumatera YEL-SOCP Batu Mbelin Sibolangit before being released into its natural habitat.
location: Aceh Selatan, Desa Blang Gelanggang Kecamatan Sawang Kabupaten Aceh Selatan

title: Pelepasliaran Orangutan Tapanuli “PAYA” di CA. Dolok Sibual-buali
summary: Orangutan Tapanuli 'Paya' was rescued from Desa Aek Batang Paya due to injuries and malnutrition, rehabilitated at PKOS in Batu Mbelin, and released into the conservation area of CA Dolok Sibual-buali.
location: Desa Aek Batang Paya, Kec. Sipirok, Kab. Tapanuli Selatan; CA Dolok Sibual-buali

title: Upaya Penyelamatan Orangutan, Balai TN Kutai Sinergi Bersama Multipihak
summary: An orangutan was spotted near a fertilizer plant's facilities and was safely handled by a coordinated effort between PT. Pupuk Kaltim, Balai Taman Nasional Kutai (TNK), and BKSDA Kalimantan Timur. The female orangutan was found to be in good health and subsequently translocated to Resor Sangkima in Taman Nasional Kutai.
location: Bontang, near the Dermaga 4 Tursina PT. Pupuk Kaltim area and later translocated to Resor Sangkima in Taman Nasional Kutai.

title: Menanti Perkembangan Kasus 5 Bayi Orangutan di Hutan India
summary: Five Sumatran baby orangutans from Indonesia were found in Odisha, India, prompting efforts for their repatriation due to their age and need for specialized care.
location: Blok Bhogarai/Udaipur, Jaleswar district, Balasore, Odisha, India (near the border with West Bengal)

title: WAKIL DPRK ACEH BARAT SERAHKAN ORANGUTAN KE BKSDA ACEH
summary: A male Sumatran Orangutan (Pongo abelii) of approximately 2 years old was handed over to BKSDA Aceh by a DPRK representative in Meulaboh, Aceh. It will undergo rehabilitation before being released back into its natural habitat.
location: Meulaboh, Aceh

title: Kemenhut dalami temuan tengkorak diduga orangutan di perkebunan Kalbar
summary: The Ministry of Environment is investigating a skull believed to be that of an Orang Utan Kalimantan (Pongo pygmaeus) found in a High Conservation Value (HCV) oil palm plantation area.
location: Kabupaten Ketapang, Kalimantan Barat

title: TRRC BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah Translokasi Orangutan dari Perkebunan Masyarakat
summary: TRRC BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah rescued a male orangutan aged 13 years from Tumbang Nusa village, Central Kalimantan, due to habitat degradation and food scarcity caused by the 2015 land fires. The orangutan was found malnourished but healthy and subsequently translocated to Camp Garuda in Sungai Koran SPTN 1 Palangka Raya.
location: Tumbang Nusa village, Kabupaten Pulang Pisau and Camp Garuda, Sungai Koran SPTN 1 Palangka Raya, Central Kalimantan

title: 2 Individu Orangutan Direscue dari Kabupaten Pulang Pisau
summary: Wildlife Rescue Unit SKW I BKSDA Kalteng along with BOSF Nyaru Menteng rescued two orangutans (an adult female and a male juvenile) from Desa Sebangau Mulya, Paduran Sebangau District, Pulang Pisau. The orangutans were found causing damage to local rubber and palm oil plantations and were subsequently translocated to a nearby forest bordering Tanjung Puting National Park.
location: Desa Sebangau Mulya, Kecamatan Paduran Sebangau, Kabupaten Pulang Pisau, Kalimantan Tengah

title: Tiga Orangutan Diselamatkan BKSDA Kalteng
summary: A team from BKSDA Kalteng rescued three Orangutans (Pongo pygmaeus sp.) found in a deserted rubber plantation area in Desa Asam Baru, Kecamatan Danau Seluluk, Kabupaten Seruyan. The Orangutans are currently being held at the Orangutan Care Center and Quarantine (OCCQ) before they will be translocated to Tanjung Puting National Park.
location: Desa Asam Baru, Kecamatan Danau Seluluk, Kabupaten Seruyan, Indonesia

title: Balai Besar KSDA Sumatera Utara Evakuasi Orangutan di Dusun Penampean, Batang Serangan
summary: A team from BBKSDA Sumatera Utara, BBTN Gunung Leuser, OIC, and WCS rescued a female Sumatran orangutan aged 30 years old in poor condition with multiple injuries near Batang Serangan, North Sumatra. The orangutan was brought to the Batu Mbelin Sibolangit quarantine center for intensive care.
location: Dusun Penampean, Desa Sei Musam, Kec. Batang Serangan, North Sumatra

title: Kembali BBKSDA Sumut Rescue dan Translokasi Orangutan
summary: Balai Besar KSDA Sumatera Utara successfully rescued and translocated three female orangutans (two adults and one juvenile) from a PT PISS plantation area in Sei Lepan, Langkat to Restorasi Cinta Raja in Gunung Leuser National Park.
location: Sei Lepan, Desa Mekar Makmur, Kecamatan Sei Lepan, Kabupaten Langkat (rescue location); Restorasi Cinta Raja, Taman Nasional Gunung Leuser (translocation destination)

title: Sosialisasi Rehabilitasi Lanjutan Orangutan di Desa Penyangga Taman Nasional Betung Kerihun
summary: Community awareness activities about orangutan rehabilitation and translocation plans were held in Desa Penyangga Taman Nasional Betung Kerihun to prepare for the release of rehabilitated orangutans into Sub DAS Mendalam, TNBKDS.
location: Kapuas Hulu, Indonesia

title: Perkembangan Monitoring Orangutan Sumatera
summary: A monitoring team successfully conducted a check on rehabilitated Sumatran Orangutans at Resort Suo Suo, observing five adult and two juvenile individuals. One Sumatran Orangutan remains in rehabilitation and has not yet been released into the wild.
location: Jambi, Indonesia

title: Karhutla Kalbar Rusak Habitat Orangutan, 30 Satwa Dievakuasi dari Area Sawit
summary: A joint team from Balai Konservasi Sumber Daya Alam (BKSDA) Kalimantan Barat and Yayasan Inisiasi Alam Rehabilitasi Indonesia (YIARI) rescued 51 orangutans in West Kalimantan due to forest fires. Thirty individuals were evacuated from an oil palm plantation area of PT KALE.
location: Kabupaten Ketapang and Kayong Utara, West Kalimantan

title: 21 Orang Utan Alami Gejala ISPA Akibat Paparan Asap Tebal Karhutla di Kalteng
summary: 21 orangutans at Nyaru Menteng rehabilitation center in Palangka Raya, Central Kalimantan, experienced ISPA due to haze from karhutla fires. BOSF and BKSDA Kalteng rescued and translocated five orangutans, including Raya and Rayu, back to their natural habitat.
location: Nyaru Menteng, Palangka Raya, Central Kalimantan, Indonesia

title: Petugas Menghalau Orangutan Tapanuli Yang Muncul di Kebun Warga
summary: Petugas from Balai Besar KSDA Sumatera Utara and Yayasan Scorpion Indonesia observed Orangutan Tapanuli in a residential garden and used firecrackers to drive them back into the forest. They also found orangutan nests, signs of activity, and snares at the location.
location: Lingkungan Pagaran Pisang, Kelurahan Arse Nauli, Kecamatan Arse, Kabupaten Tapanuli Selatan

title: Pulau Pra-Pelepasliaran Orangutan Balai KSDA Kalteng
summary: BOSF and BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah relocated 12 rescued orangutans to a pre-release island in Pulang Pisau for further rehabilitation before eventual release.
location: Pulau Salat, Desa Pilang, Kecamatan Jabiren Raya, Kabupaten Pulang Pisau

title: Tim Balai KSDA Kalbar Kembali Evakuasi Orangutan dari Masyarakat
summary: A male orangutan aged approximately 3 years was rescued by a team from Balai KSDA Kalbar in Sintang. The orangutan was confiscated from its owner who received legal education, and it will be rehabilitated at the Sintang Orangutan Center before being released back to its natural habitat.
location: Desa Kebong, Kecamatan Kelam, Kabupaten Sintang, Kalimantan Barat, Indonesia

title: Kepungan Api Tinggal 200 Meter, Enam Orangutan Terjebak di Perkebunan Warga usai Akses Hutan Putus
summary: Six orangutans were trapped in a resident's oil palm plantation during a forest fire in Kayong Utara, West Kalimantan. A rescue team from BKSDA West Kalimantan and YIARI rescued the orangutans, who were experiencing dehydration and high fever due to heat and smoke exposure.
location: Desa Pemangkat, Kecamatan Simpang Hilir, Kabupaten Kayong Utara, West Kalimantan

title: TIM WRU SKW II BKSDA KALTENG KEMBALI AMANKAN 2 INDIVIDU ORANGUTAN
summary: A team from BKSDA Kalteng rescued two orangutans (an adult female and a young one) from Desa Bagendang Hilir in Kotawaringin Timur, Indonesia, and later translocated them to Suaka Margasatwa Lamandau.
location: Desa Bagendang Hilir, Kec. Mentaya Hilir Utara, Kab. Kotawaringin Timur, Indonesia; Suaka Margasatwa Lamandau

title: Kali Ketiga SKW I Ketapang BKSDA Kalbar Menerima Orangutan Dari Masyarakat
summary: An individual female orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus) named ISIN, approximately 3 years old and in good health, was rescued from a local farmer by the BKSDA Kalimantan Barat team on October 3, 2017. The orangutan is now undergoing rehabilitation at YIARI-Ketapang.
location: Desa Bayuabang, Kecamatan Teluk Batang, Kabupaten Kayong Utara, Kalimantan Barat

title: Anak Orangutan Ditemukan Sendirian di Kotim, Sempat Ditempatkan dalam Wadah Ikan
summary: A female orangutan infant was found alone near a village road by a resident who then reported it to conservation authorities. The BKSDA received the report and safely took custody of the animal for further care.
location: Desa Bagendang Tengah, Kabupaten Kotawaringin Timur (Kotim), Kalimantan Tengah

title: Satgas BKSDA Kaltim Evakuasi Orangutan Danau Redan
summary: A male orangutan approximately 20 years old was rescued from Danau Redan village by a BKSDA Kaltim team in collaboration with local authorities and villagers. The orangutan was found healthy, named Rizal, and subsequently translocated to Resort Sangkima within Taman Nasional Kutai.
location: Danau Redan village, Teluk Pandan District, Kutai Timur

title: Tak Henti Melangkah Mendukung Terlaksananya SRAK Orangutan
summary: Balai KSDA Kalimantan Barat, in collaboration with rehabilitation centers in West Kalimantan Province, has been working on efforts to release rehabilitated orangutans back into their natural habitat, while also addressing ongoing conservation challenges such as habitat loss and illegal wildlife trade.
location: Pontianak, Kalimantan Barat

title: BKSDA Kalteng Lakukan Penyelamatan Dua Individu Orangutan
summary: A rescue team from Wildlife Rescue Unit of Balai KSDA Kalimantan Tengah along with Orangutan Foundation International rescued two orangutans (a mother and her baby) found in a rubber plantation. They are currently undergoing health checks before planned release into their natural habitat, Suaka Margasatwa Lamandau.
location: Desa Baamang Barat, Kecamatan Baamang, Kabupaten Kotawaringin Timur, Kalimantan Tengah

title: DINI HARI, ORANGUTAN SEBERAT 90 KG DIRESCUE DARI DESA BAGENDANG HILIR
summary: A male orangutan weighing 90 kg was rescued from Desa Bagendang Hilir by a team from BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah and subsequently translocated to Suaka Margasatwa Lamandau.
location: Desa Bagendang Hilir, Kec. Bagendang, Kab. Kotawaringin Timur, Kalimantan Tengah

title: Upaya Kolaboratif Penyelamatan Orangutan Tapanuli oleh BBKSDA Sumut dan Mitra di Arse
summary: A male Tapanuli Orangutan (Pongo tapanuliensis) aged about 20 years was rescued from a paddy field in Desa Aek Haminjon, Kecamatan Arse, Tapanuli Selatan. The orangutan had injuries and was taken to Sumatran Rescue Alliance for intensive treatment with the hope of eventually returning it to its natural habitat.
location: Desa Aek Haminjon, Kecamatan Arse, Kabupaten Tapanuli Selatan

title: Kronologi Orang Utan Ditemukan Tak Sadarkan Diri di Kebun Sawit Ketapang Kalbar
summary: A male adult orangutan was found unconscious near an oil palm plantation in Ketapang, West Kalimantan, likely due to smoke inhalation from recent forest fires. A joint team of BKSDA and YIARI rescued the orangutan, provided medical assistance, and began treatment for respiratory issues.
location: Desa Laman Satong, Kecamatan Matan Hilir Utara, Kabupaten Ketapang, Kalimantan Barat (West Kalimantan)

title: Terpapar Asap Karhutla, Orang Utan Ditemukan Tak Sadarkan Diri di Kebun Sawit Ketapang
summary: A male adult orangutan named Sampurna was found unconscious near a palm oil plantation in Ketapang due to smoke inhalation from forest fires. It was rescued by a joint team from BKSDA Kalbar and YIARI, treated for respiratory issues, and evacuated to the Orangutan Rescue Center YIARI in Sungai Awan Kiri.
location: Desa Laman Satong, Kecamatan Matan Hilir Utara, Kabupaten Ketapang, Kalimantan Barat (Kalbar)

title: Penandatanganan Nota Kesepahaman dan Perjanjian Kerjasama Ditjen KSDAE dengan Yayasan Penyelamatan Orangutan Borneo
summary: A Memorandum of Understanding and Cooperation Agreement were signed between KSDAE with Yayasan Penyelamatan Orangutan Borneo (Yayasan BOS) for orangutan conservation in Kalimantan, including rescue operations, translocations, and rehabilitation efforts.
location: Jakarta, Indonesia

title: Hari Primata Indonesia, TaNa Bentarum & Mitra Lepasliarkan Dua Individu Orangutan
summary: Two rehabilitated Orangutans, Tera and Moni, were released back into their natural habitat in Taman Nasional Betung Kerihun as part of a joint effort between Balai Besar TaNa Bentarum, Yayasan Penyelamatan Orangutan Sintang (YPOS), and BKSDA Kalimantan Barat.
location: Taman Nasional Betung Kerihun, Padua Mendalam, Indonesia

title: Translokasi Orangutan Di Penghujung Tahun 2018
summary: A male orangutan weighing 69.5 kg and aged 30 years was rescued from Asam Baru village on December 28, 2018, due to causing damage in a durian orchard. It was then released into Tanjung Puting National Park after health checks.
location: Tanjung Puting National Park, Kalimantan Tengah, Indonesia

title: Nasib Orangutan Raya dan Rayu Usai Diselamatkan dari Karhutla, Masih Tunggu Hasil Laboratorium
summary: Induk dan anak orangutan, Raya dan Rayu, diselamatkan dari kawasan terdampak kebakaran hutan (karhutla) di Hutan Kota Sampit, Kotawaringin Timur, Kalimantan Tengah. Mereka sedang menunggu hasil laboratorium untuk menentukan langkah selanjutnya termasuk lokasi translokasi.
location: Hutan Kota Sampit, Kotawaringin Timur (Kotim), Kalimantan Tengah

title: Orangutan Sambangi Kebun Durian Warga di Tangkahan
summary: A Sumatran Orangutan was found in a durian orchard near Tangkahan, and efforts were made to relocate it back into Gunung Leuser National Park.
location: Tangkahan, Desa Namo Sialang, Kecamatan Batang Serangan, Kabupaten Langkat

title: Bayi Orangutan Morio TN KUTAI Kembali di Selamatkan
summary: A male orangutan infant of approximately 1 year old was rescued by staff at Sangkima Resort SPTN Wilayah I Sangatta Balai Taman Nasional Kutai in East Kalimantan, Indonesia. The orangutan was handed over to Balai KSDA Kaltim for further care and potential rehabilitation by Yayasan Jejak Pulang.
location: Sangkima Resort SPTN Wilayah I Sangatta, Balai Taman Nasional Kutai, East Kalimantan, Indonesia

title: Pemulangan 5 Orangutan Sumatera Ke Habitatnya di Jantho, Aceh
summary: The Balai Besar KSDA Sumatera Utara released 5 Sumatran Orangutans (Pongo abelii) back to their habitat in the Jantho Wildlife Tourism Park, Aceh. The orangutans were part of a 'Forest School' program and had been affected by negative human-wildlife interactions.
location: Jantho, Aceh Besar, Aceh, Indonesia

title: Penanganan Orangutan Terisolir di Tapaktuan Aceh Selatan
summary: A male Sumatran Orangutan (Pongo abelii) approximately 20 years old was rescued from a cocoa plantation in Air Pinang, Tapaktuan, Aceh Selatan. The orangutan is healthy and planned to be relocated to SOCP's reintroduction station in TWA Jantho, Aceh Besar.
location: Desa Air Pinang, Kecamatan Tapaktuan, Kabupaten Aceh Selatan (rescue), Stasiun Reintroduksi Orangutan SOCP in TWA Jantho, Aceh Besar (planned relocation)

title: Kolaborasi BBKSDA Sumatera Utara dan OVAID untuk Penguatan Upaya Konservasi Orangutan
summary: BBKSDA Sumatera Utara received a donation of Emergency Kit Bags from Orangutan Veterinary Aid (OVAID) to support rescue, rehabilitation, and release efforts for orangutans in Sumatera Utara and Aceh. OVAID also provided medical equipment after the Batu Mbelin Rehabilitation Center was damaged by landslides.
location: Sumatera Utara and Aceh, Batu Mbelin Rehabilitation Center, Sibolangit

title: Joy Kembali Masuk Sekolah Orangutan
summary: Joy, an orangutan female released into Taman Nasional Betung Kerihun on April 17, 2018, was brought back to the Sintang Orangutan Center for further rehabilitation as she showed signs of not being ready to live independently in her natural habitat.
location: Sintang, Taman Nasional Betung Kerihun (Kawasan DAS Mendalam)

title: WRU BKSDA Kalteng Rescue Orangutan Seberat 87,7 kg di Dusun Remiling, Kotawaringin Timur
summary: Wildlife Rescue Team BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah rescued an 87.7 kg orangutan from Dusun Remiling, Seranau District, Kotawaringin Timur after it entered a village and started consuming fruits in the local orchards.
location: Dusun Remiling, Desa Ganepo, Kec. Seranau, Kab. Kotawaringin Timur

title: Rescue Orangutan di Kobar Kalteng oleh BKSDA Kalteng
summary: A male orangutan aged 17 years was rescued from a village near Arsel District in Kubar Regency due to habitat encroachment by oil palm plantations and frequent crop-raiding incidents. It is being held in a transit cage at BKSDA Kalteng's SKW II facility and plans are in place for its release into the Lamandau Protected Forest Habitat.
location: Desa Mendawai Seberang, Kecamatan Arsel, Kabupaten Kubar, Kalimantan Tengah

title: BKSDA: sembilan orangutan korban karhutla dilepasliarkan di Ketapang
summary: Nine Orangutan Kalimantan (Pongo pygmaeus) were rescued from areas affected by forest fires and deforestation in Ketapang, West Kalimantan, and released into a protected forest area named Hutan Lindung Batu Nyambu.
location: Ketapang, West Kalimantan, Indonesia; Hutan Lindung Batu Nyambu

title: Patugas Berhasil Membekuk Pembunuh Orangutan Tanpa Kepala
summary: Two suspects were arrested for killing an orangutan near Sungai Maduru, Maligoi village, Montalat district, Barut regency, Central Kalimantan. The suspects shot the orangutan 17 times and decapitated it after it allegedly attacked them while they were tapping rubber trees in a nearby plantation.
location: Sungai Maduru, Maligoi village, Montalat district, Barut regency, Central Kalimantan

title: Penyelamatan Orangutan Sumatera di Longkib Kota Subulussalam
summary: A male Sumatran orangutan was rescued from an oil palm plantation area in Longkib Subulussalam due to being in poor health and requiring medical treatment.
location: Longkib, Subulussalam, Aceh, Indonesia

title: Saatnya Hukum Mencintai Orangutan
summary: Petugas law enforcement successfully intercepted and seized one individual of Sumatran Orangutan in Medan and Langsa, Aceh, respectively, and convicted the perpetrators for illegal trade.
location: Medan, Langsa, Aceh Tamiang, Aceh

title: Orangutan Hasil Repatriasi Dilepasliarkan di TN Bukit Baka Bukit Raya
summary: Four female orangutans, including Pangkuy, Sisil, Clara, and Clarita, were released into Bukit Baka Bukit Raya National Park after rehabilitation.
location: Bukit Baka Bukit Raya National Park, Kabupaten Katingan, Indonesia

title: Libur Idul Fitri Petugas Pohut tetap Siaga Rescue Orangutan
summary: A female orangutan approximately 7 years old was rescued after being reportedly injured in a conflict with local banana plantation owners in Tanjung Rengas Seruyan. She was evacuated to the Care Centre Orangutan in Pangkalan Bun for treatment and rehabilitation.
location: Tanjung Rengas Seruyan, Kalimantan Tengah, Indonesia

title: Dua Individu Orangutan Berhasil Dievakuasi dan Dilepasliarkan Kembali
summary: Two orangutans were found injured near Sumber Bakti village; one was healthy while the other was malnourished with gunshot wounds around its eyelid and right chest. The animals were then evacuated for release in Jantho Conservation Area.
location: Desa Sumber Bakti, Kecamatan Darul Makmur, Kabupaten Nagan Raya, Aceh

title: Enam Orangutan Translokasi Ke SRO Bukit Tiga Puluh Jambi
summary: Six Sumatran Orangutans were translocated from Batu Mbelin Sibolangit to Bukit Tiga Puluh Jambi through road transport after health checks.
location: From Batu Mbelin Sibolangit, Sumatera Utara to Bukit Tiga Puluh, Jambi

title: Semangat kesembuhan Orangutan “Jack”
summary: An orangutan named Jack, aged 10 years old, was translocated from SPTN 1 Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya (TNBBBR) to International Animal Rescue (IAR) in Ketapang due to health issues. The journey took approximately 20 hours and involved multiple agencies for the orangutan's welfare.
location: Sintang, SPTN 1 Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya (TNBBBR), Kabupaten Ketapang

title: Kembali BKSDA Kalbar dan Mitra Melepasliarkan Orangutan dan Kukang
summary: A rescued orangutan named Bunga and three kukangs were released back into their natural habitat by BKSDA Kalbar and YIARI in Gunung Tayap Pangkalan Teluk.
location: Gunung Tayap Pangkalan Teluk, Nanga Tayap, Ketapang, West Kalimantan

title: BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah Lakukan Translokasi Orangutan ke SM Lamandau
summary: A male orangutan aged 15 years and weighing approximately 60 kg was rescued from Desa Mendawai Seberang on October 24, 2016, and translocated to Sungai Buluh SM Lamandau by a rescue team from BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah.
location: Desa Mendawai Seberang, Sungai Buluh SM Lamandau, Kalimantan Tengah

title: Zoya, Anak Orangutan Yang Terpisah Dari Induknya
summary: An orphaned wild orangutan female, approximately one year old, fell from a durian tree after being separated from her mother who was disturbed by another rehabilitated orangutan (PENI). The animal was rescued and evacuated to the Ketapang Rehabilitation Center for further rehabilitation before eventual release back into its natural habitat.
location: Ketapang, Gunung Tarak

title: Tim WRU SKW II Balai KSDA Kalimantan Tengah Kembali Rescue Orangutan dari Perkebunan Sawit
summary: A female orangutan aged 6 years and weighing 9 kg was rescued from an oil palm plantation in Seruyan, Central Kalimantan by a Wildlife Rescue Unit team from BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah and Orangutan Foundation International. The orangutan is now at the Orangutan Care Centre Quarantine Pasir Panjang for health checks.
location: Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit Milik PT. WSSL 2, Desa Parang Batang, Kec. Hanau, Kab. Seruyan, Central Kalimantan

title: Selamat Datang Ke Dunia Wahai Orangutan Muda
summary: Tim Monitoring Sintang Orangutan Center (SOC) encountered Putri Tanjung, a rehabilitated Bornean orangutan released in 2019, carrying her newborn infant in the Resort Nanga Hovat area of Tanjung Puting National Park. This marks continued successful breeding efforts among reintroduced orangutans.
location: Resort Nanga Hovat, Taman Nasional Betung Kerihun (Tanjung Puting National Park), Kalimantan

title: 48 Satwa Liar Diselamatkan dari Karhutla Kalteng, 25 di Antaranya Orangutan
summary: Novita, a four-year-old female orangutan with serious burn injuries on her hands and feet, was rescued from a forest fire in Central Kalimantan and is undergoing intensive rehabilitation at the Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation (BOSF). Additionally, 48 wild animals were saved, including 25 orangutans, during the same incident.
location: Katune, Kelurahan Banturung, Kecamatan Bukit Batu, Kota Palangka Raya, Central Kalimantan

title: Pelepasliaran Orangutan “Nayo”
summary: An orangutan named 'Nayo' was rescued from a pineapple plantation where it was causing damage, received health checks, and was subsequently released into Bukit Daun Sandar in the Gunung Palung National Park area.
location: Ketapang, Indonesia (rescue from Desa Tanjungpura Kecamatan Muara Lawan Kabupaten Ketapang, released in Bukit Daun Sandar Dusun Sungai Putih Desa Teluk Bayur Kecamatan Sungai Laur Kabupaten Ketapang)

title: Penyerahan Orangutan dari Warga Desa Sangkima
summary: A female orangutan, aged 3 years with a weight of 8 kg, was rescued from Desa Sangkima and handed over to Balai Taman Nasional Kutai before being transferred for rehabilitation at Yayasan Jejak Pulang in Samarinda.
location: Desa Sangkima, Kecamatan Sangata Selatan, and Samarinda, Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia

title: BBKSDA Sumatera Utara Kirim 5 Orangutan ke Jambi
summary: Five Sumatran orangutans were successfully rehabilitated at PKOS Batu Mbelin and then translocated to Jambi for reintroduction to their natural habitat.
location: Jambi, Indonesia (Stasiun Reintroduksi Orangutan Bukit Tigapuluh FZS)

title: Kisah Sedih Novita dan Penderitaan Puluhan Orangutan Kalimantan Akibat Hutannya Terbakar
summary: Novita, a female Bornean orangutan approximately 5 years old, was rescued from a burning forest area in Katune, Banturung, Bukit Batu, Palangka Raya, Central Kalimantan. She was found on a sengon tree with severe burn injuries and subsequently underwent amputation of four toes.
location: Katune, Banturung, Bukit Batu, Palangka Raya, Central Kalimantan; Kotawaringin Timur, Central Kalimantan; Hutan Lindung Batu Nyambu, Kabupaten Ketapang

title: Lagi, Orangutan Tapanuli Sambangi Kebun Warga
summary: An Orangutan Tapanuli was sighted in a resident's durian orchard in Desa Pagaran Pisang and was subsequently chased away using a mercon device by a joint team from Konservasi Wilayah V Sipirok and YOSL-OIC. The male orangutan was guided towards the Dolok Sipirok Wildlife Reserve, while two other individuals (likely mother and child) remained in the area.
location: Desa Pagaran Pisang, Kecamatan Arse Nauli, Kabupaten Tapanuli Selatan, Indonesia

title: TN Bukit Baka Bukit Raya Kembali Menjadi Rumah Baru Bagi Lima Individu Orangutan
summary: Five rehabilitated orangutans were released back into Bukit Baka Bukit Raya National Park (BTNBBBR) in Sintang, West Kalimantan, Indonesia. The individuals were previously rescued and rehabilitated due to various circumstances such as being injured, illegally kept as pets, or orphaned.
location: Bukit Baka Bukit Raya National Park, Sintang, West Kalimantan, Indonesia

title: Rescue Orangutan Sumatera Terisolir
summary: A Sumatran Orangutan was rescued from an isolated location in a rubber plantation by a joint team from Balai Besar KSDA Sumatera Utara and HOCRU Orangutan Information Center (OIC). The orangutan was found healthy and released into the Hutan Restorasi Resort Cinta Raja in Gunung Leuser National Park.
location: Perladangan karet, Dusun 8 Desa Sei Litur Tasik Kecamatan Sawit Seberang Kabupaten Langkat, Sumatera Utara

title: BBKSDA Sumatera Utara Kembali Rescue Orangutan Dari Perkebunan PT. PISS
summary: A female Sumatran orangutan was rescued from a palm oil plantation by a joint team of BBKSDA Sumatera Utara and YOSL-OIC, and subsequently translocated to Hutan Restorasi Cinta Raja in Gunung Leuser National Park.
date: 25 July 2022 (rescue reported on this date, actual rescue on Jumat, 22 Juli 2022)
location: Desa Makmur, Kecamatan Sei Lepan, Kabupaten Langkat, Sumatera Utara, Indonesia

title: Dari Wilayah Perkebunan Sawit, WRU SKW II BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah Rescue Induk Orangutan dan Anaknya
summary: Wildlife Rescue Unit SKW II BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah rescued an adult female orangutan aged 25 years weighing 39 kg and her 3-year-old female offspring weighing 4 kg from a palm oil plantation area in Desa Sembuluh, Kec. Danau Sembuluh, Kab. Seruyan.
location: Desa Sembuluh, Kec. Danau Sembuluh, Kab. Seruyan, Kalimantan tengah

title: Balai Besar KSDA Sumatera Utara Sambut Kedatangan Orangutan Sumatera dari Yogyakarta
summary: An individual Sumatran Orangutan (Pongo abelii) was received at Kuala Namu International Airport, Deli Serdang, North Sumatra, on August 25, 2022, for rehabilitation and eventual release into its natural habitat.
location: Kuala Namu International Airport, Deli Serdang, North Sumatra

title: Kronologi Penyelamatan Satwa Orangutan Di Lembaga Konservasi Sinka Zoo
summary: An orangutan was rescued from an unknown member of the public by Lembaga Konservasi Sinka Island Park and later evacuated to Pusat Rehabilitasi Yayasan IAR Indonesia for rehabilitation.
location: Pontianak, Kalimantan Barat, Indonesia

title: Terisolir di Kebun Karet Warga, Petugas BBKSDA Sumut Translokasi Orangutan
summary: A Sumatran Orangutan (Pongo abelii) was rescued from an isolated area in a rubber plantation near PT. Prins in Sei Serdang, Langkat. It was translocated to the Hutan Restorasi Cinta Raja within Gunung Leuser National Park.
location: Desa Sei Serdang, Kabupaten Langkat, Sumatera Utara

title: Balai KSDA Kalteng Evakuasi Orangutan Jantan Dari Sukamara
summary: A male orangutan was evacuated from a rice field in Sukamara by a team from BKSDA Kalteng after causing damage to local crops and disrupting community activities. The orangutan, weighing 90 kg and estimated to be 17 years old, will be translocated to Sungai Lamandau Wildlife Sanctuary.
location: Desa Sungai Raja, Jelai, Sukamara, Kalimantan Tengah

title: Diduga Terkena Jerat Babi hingga Luka Parah, Induk Orangutan Usia 25 Tahun dan Anaknya Diselamatkan
summary: Induk orangutan named Gadis, estimated to be 25 years old, and her young male offspring Garis, about 10 months old, were rescued from entanglement in snares near Desa Kandan.
location: Desa Kandan, Kecamatan Kota Besi, Kabupaten Kotawaringin Timur, Kalimantan Tengah, Indonesia

title: Orangutan Found Injured by Snare Amid Forest and Land Fires, Now Evacuated
summary: A female orangutan named Gadis and her baby, Garis, were rescued from an area affected by forest and land fires in Central Kalimantan. Gadis was found injured by snares around her wrists.
location: Kandan Village, Kotawaringin Timur Regency, Central Kalimantan

title: BKSDA selamatkan induk dan anak orangutan yang terjerat di Kotim
summary: BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah successfully rescued an adult female orangutan (Gadis) and her 10-month-old male infant (Garis) who were entangled in a village area in Desa Kandan, Kota Besi, Kotawaringin Timur.
location: Desa Kandan, Kecamatan Kota Besi, Kotawaringin Timur, Kalimantan Tengah

title: Terisolir, Orangutan Direscue Tim Gabungan
summary: A Sumatran orangutan was found isolated in a palm oil plantation area and was rescued by a joint team from Balai Besar KSDA Sumatera Utara and Yayasan Orangutan Sumatera Lestari-Orangutan Information Centre (YOSL-OIC). The healthy male orangutan, aged around 10 years and weighing 45 kg, was then translocated to Hutan Restorasi Cinta Raja in Gunung Leuser National Park.
location: Desa Mekar Makmur, Kecamatan Sei Lepan, kabupaten Langkat, Sumatera Utara

title: Evakuasi Orangutan di BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah
summary: A rescue team from BKSDA Kalimantan Tengah rescued an adult female orangutan and her young female offspring that were causing damage to local farms in Hyang Bana village. The orangutans were taken to a rehabilitation center for health checks before being translocated to Bukit Baka Bukit Raya National Park.
location: Hyang Bana village, Central Kalimantan

title: BBKSDA Sumatera Utara Lepasliarkan Orangutan Tapanuli di CA Dolok Sipirok
summary: An Orangutan Tapanuli (Pongo tapanuliensis) was rescued from a village in Sipirok, Sumatera Utara, after entering a populated area for several days and was then translocated back to Cagar Alam Dolok Sipirok.
location: Dusun Padang Bulan, Desa Marsada, Kecamatan Sipirok; Cagar Alam Dolok Sipirok, Sumatera Utara

title: Evakuasi Orangutan Dalam Koper di Bandara Ngurah Rai
summary: Customs officials at Ngurah Rai Airport in Bali intercepted a passenger attempting to smuggle an Orangutan in a suitcase on a Garuda Indonesia flight from Seoul to Vladivostok.
location: Ngurah Rai Airport, Denpasar, Bali

title: Joy dan Utu, 2 Orangutan Hasil Evakuasi BKSDA Kalbar Melalui Info Call Center
summary: Joy and Utu, two 5-year-old orangutans who were kept as pets, were rescued by a team from BKSDA Kalbar and YIARI Ketapang in Desa Semandang Hulu, Ketapang. They are currently at an orangutan rehabilitation center in Ketapang where they will be trained to live independently before being released back into their natural habitat.
location: Ketapang, Desa Semandang Hulu

title: Warga Serahkan Orangutan Sumatera di Indra Makmur Aceh Timur
summary: A Sumatran Orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus abelii) was rescued by conservation personnel from an individual in Indra Makmur, Aceh Timur, and will be quarantined and rehabilitated at YEL-SOCP Batu Mbelin Sibolangit.
location: Indra Makmur, Aceh Timur, Indonesia

title: Kementerian Kehutanan Pulangkan Empat Orangutan Korban Perdagangan Ilegal dari Thailand
summary: Four orangutans, including three Sumatran orangutans (Pongo abelii) and one Tapanuli orangutan (Pongo tapanuliensis), were repatriated from Thailand to Indonesia after being seized as illegal wildlife trade victims. They were transported to the Sumatran Rescue Alliance (SRA) for rehabilitation.
location: Thailand and Medan, North Sumatra, Indonesia

title: “Translokasi Orangutan Kalimantan dan Beruang Madu”
summary: Jono, an Orangutan Kalimantan (Pongo pygmaeus), was prepared for translocation from Jakarta to the Orangutan Care Center and Quarantine (OCCQ) in Pangkalan Bun, Central Kalimantan, with the intention of eventual rehabilitation and release into its natural habitat.
location: Jakarta to Desa Pasir Panjang Kotawaringin Barat, Pangkalan Bun, Central Kalimantan

title: Pelepasliaran 6 Individu Orangutan di Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya
summary: Six orangutans were released back into their natural habitat at Tanjung Puting National Park (Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya) in May 2017 as part of a joint initiative between the park and the Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation.
location: Sungai Bemban, Resort Tumbang Hiran SPTN Wilayah II Kasongan - Tanjung Puting National Park (Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya)

title: Seksi Konservasi Wilayah II Subulussalam Evakuasi Dan Translokasi Orangutan Sumatera
summary: Personnel from the Conservation Section II Subulussalam and the Orangutan Information Center (OIC) rescued a Sumatran Orangutan that had entered a village plantation in Desa Pulo Paya, Aceh Selatan. The orangutan was then translocated to Rawa Singkil Wildlife Sanctuary.
location: Aceh Selatan, Indonesia (specific incident at Desa Pulo Paya, Trumo Tengah, Aceh Selatan; translocated to Suaka Margasatwa Rawa Singkil)

title: Memindahkan Lamtuha ke Stasiun Reintroduksi Orangutan Sumatera Jantho Aceh Besar
summary: A Sumatran Orangutan named Lamtuha was rescued from an isolated area threatened by oil palm plantation expansion on February 21, 2019, and translocated to the Jantho Aceh Great Nature Conservation Park for eventual reintroduction.
location: Jantho Aceh Besar, Aceh Barat Daya, Indonesia

title: Perjuangan 8 Jam Evakuasi 3 Orangutan di Tengah Kepungan Asap Karhutla Ketapang
summary: A team of conservationists rescued three orangutans, including an adult named Mama Yuni and her two offspring Yuni and Pura, from a village plantation in Ketapang after a forest fire had destroyed their habitat.
location: Desa Tanjungpura, Kecamatan Muara Pawan, Kabupaten Ketapang, Kalimantan Barat

title: Evakuasi Orangutan Sumatera Korban Tindakan Kekerasan
summary: An orangutan was evicted from a village due to violence inflicted upon it and was taken for medical care but did not survive due to injuries including a broken backbone and physical abuse marks.
location: Desa Kuta Pengkih, Mardinding, Karo, Sumatera

title: Kematian satu Individu Orangutan Sumatera
summary: A male Sumatran Orangutan estimated to be 25 years old was found dead after about two weeks near Lae trep in Desa Rantau Gedang, Kecamatan Singkil, Aceh Singkil. The cause of death could not be determined definitively, and an investigation is underway.
location: Lae trep Desa Rantau Gedang, Kecamatan Singkil, Kabupaten Aceh Singkil

title: Untuk Kesekian Kalinya Orangutan Dikembalikan Ke Habitatnya
summary: Four orangutans were released back into their natural habitat in Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya (TNBBBR) by a joint team of wildlife officials and conservationists. The individuals, named MAMA LAILA, LILI, VIJAY, and LISA, underwent various stages of rescue and rehabilitation before being reintroduced to their native environment.
location: Ketapang, Taman Nasional Bukit Baka Bukit Raya (TNBBBR)

title: Penyelamatan Seekor Orangutan
summary: A young male orangutan was rescued from an illegal transportation situation by authorities in Pekanbaru. The orangutan, believed to be a Sumatran Orangutan (Pongo abelli), was being transported via bus without proper documentation and is now undergoing rehabilitation.
location: Pekanbaru, Riau, Indonesia

title: Tim WRU SKW II BKSDA Kalteng Rescue Induk Orangutan beserta Anaknya dari Kebun Masyarakat di Desa Lada Mandala Jaya
summary: A team from BKSDA Kalteng rescued an adult orangutan with its three-year-old female offspring from a community rubber plantation in Desa Lada Mandala Jaya, Kotawaringin Barat, and subsequently translocated them to Tanjung Puting National Park.
location: Desa Lada Mandala Jaya, Kec. Pangkalan Lada, Kab. Kotawaringin Barat; Taman Nasional Tanjung Puting

title: Tiga Orangutan Kembali ke Hutan Kehje Sewen, Satu Individu Tertunda karena Ini
summary: Three rehabilitated orangutans were released back into Hutan Kehje Sewen, East Kutai District, East Kalimantan, with one male orangutan delayed due to diarrhea.

title: Villagers hand over young orangutan to conservation officials: BKSDA
summary: A four-year-old female orangutan found beside a village road in Central Kalimantan was handed over to conservation authorities for examination and care.

title: BOSF-BKSDA Kaltim lepas liarkan tiga orangutan ke Hutan Kehje Sewen
summary: BOSF-BKSDA Kaltim released three rehabilitated orangutans (Dennis, Amesh, Catherine) back into Hutan Kehje Sewen in Kutai Timur.

title: BOSF Lepasliarkan Tiga Orangutan Rehabilitasi ke Hutan Kehje Sewen Kutai Timur
summary: BOSF Samboja Lestari released three rehabilitated orangutans—Dennis, Amesh, and Catherine—to Hutan Kehje Sewen in Kutai Timur.

title: Cagar Alam Jantho dan Masa Depan Orangutan Sumatera
summary: Orangutans, including Bombom, that were previously kept captive underwent rehabilitation and were reintroduced to the wild at Jantho Pine Forest Conservation Area in Aceh, Indonesia, through a soft release process.

title: NINE RESCUED ORANGUTANS, INCLUDING THREE PREGNANT MOTHERS, RELEASED INTO FIRE-FREE FOREST
summary: Nine rescued orangutans, including three pregnant mothers and their infants, were released into Batu Nyambu Protected Forest after being dehydrated and malnourished following fires in West Kalimantan.

title: BKSDA Kaltim Bersama Mitra Berhasil Selamatkan dan Translokasikan Induk-Anak Orangutan
summary: BKSDA Kaltim and its partners rescued a mother and infant orangutan that had wandered into an area with human activity in Kutai Timur, Indonesia, on October 10, 2026. The pair was found healthy and subsequently translocated to Hutan Kehje Sewen (PBPH PT RHOI) on October 11, 2026.

title: 9 Orangutan Korban Karhutla Dilepasliarkan di Hutan Lindung Batu Nyambu Ketapang, 3 Sedang Hamil
summary: Nine Kalimantan orangutans rescued from forest fires were translocated to a protected forest area in Ketapang, West Kalimantan, after receiving intensive rehabilitation.

title: INFANT ORANGUTAN IRENE FEATURED ON BBC NEWS AFTER RESCUE FROM FIRES
summary: Infant orangutan Irene and her mother were rescued from forest fires in an oil palm plantation within a high conservation value forest area in West Kalimantan after days without food. They were taken to YIARI’s rehabilitation centre for urgent medical care.

title: Mother orangutan and her infant rescued in Central Kalimantan
summary: A mother orangutan named Gadis and her 10-month-old infant named Garis were rescued from Kandan Village by officers from the Central Kalimantan Natural Resources Conservation Agency after being found entangled in snares.

title: Dua Orangutan Korban Karhutla di Ketapang Dipindah ke Habitat Baru
summary: Two orangutans named Adil and Gigih were rescued from areas affected by forest fires in West Kalimantan and translocated to a new habitat.

title: Indonesia releases two orangutans into the wild in W Kalimantan
summary: Forestry Minister Raja Juli Antoni released two Bornean orangutans, Adil and Gigih, into their natural habitat in Ketapang, West Kalimantan, after they were evacuated from an oil palm plantation.

title: Menhut lepasliarkan dua orangutan hasil penyelamatan di Kalbar
summary: The Minister of Environment Raja Juli Antoni released two rescued Bornean orangutans (Pongo pygmaeus) back into their natural habitat in Ketapang, West Kalimantan.

title: Dievakuasi dari Kebun Sawit, Dua Orangutan Kembali ke Habitat Alami di Kalimantan Barat
summary: Two male orangutans, Adil (8 years) and Gigih (10 years), were rescued from an oil palm plantation in Desa Laman Satong, Ketapang, West Kalimantan, and released back into their natural habitat.
